designationHistory.indexText: Formally established in 1970 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act as an inviolate sanctuary for migratory birds; the first lands were acquired in 1974.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: San Pablo Bay National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

Federal Register, July 26, 2006 (E6-11915), San Pablo Bay NWR CCP notice: "the Refuge was formally established in 1970, lands were not acquired until 1974"; established "for use as an inviolate sanctuary ... for migratory birds"

review.note: Draft 1974 is the first land acquisition, taken from a timeline line about the acquisition boundary. Formal establishment was 1970.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: San Pablo Bay National Wildlife Refuge acquisition boundary was established to include 23,702 acres 1974 – The first refuge lands were acquired by the U.S.
